definitions.explanation: Monetary donations given to content creators during live streams or to support their work, typically through platforms like YouTube, Twitch, or Japanese services.
The original meaning: coins thrown to street performers or into offering boxes at shrines and temples.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配信者|はいしんしゃ}→配信者：16573_haishinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投|な}げ{銭|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{投|な}げ{銭|せん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{10万円|じゅうまんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧⟦{配信者|はいしんしゃ}→配信者：16573_haishinsha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

I tossed a coin in front of the temple and put my hands together in prayer.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to throw) + ⟦{銭|せん}→noentry⟧ (coin/money). Originally referred to coins thrown to performers or into offering boxes.

MODERN USAGE:
In the 2010s-2020s, {投|な}げ{銭|せん} became the standard Japanese term for online tipping on streaming platforms. It covers features like:
・⟦スーパーチャット→noentry⟧ (Super Chat on YouTube)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん} features on Japanese platforms
・Donations on Twitch and similar services

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to tip)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send a tip)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貰|もら}う→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to receive tips)
・{投|な}げ{銭|せん}⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (tipping culture)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦スーパーチャット→noentry⟧/⟦スパチャ→noentry⟧ (Super Chat)
・⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧ (live streaming)
・⟦{配信者|はいしんしゃ}→配信者：16573_haishinsha⟧ (streamer)
・⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to throw, also used alone for tipping)
・⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to spend money on digital content)
